subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw core expose per-agent plugin installation now, and if so what security/lifecycle contract must ship with the first `--agent` surface?
rationale: The implementation changes trusted plugin code roots and persisted install identity, and the safe behavior depends on maintainer-owned choices about provenance, precedence, discovery, upgrade, and cleanup semantics.

options.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract Before Merge
options.body: Define and implement scoped install identity across install, uninstall, update, registry/index metadata, discovery, doctor, docs, and security validation before exposing the CLI flag.

options.title: Pause For Product Review
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused while maintainers decide whether per-agent plugin installs belong in core and which guarantees they require.

options.title: Accept Install-Only Experiment
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally merge a partial install-only feature, but operators would hit known uninstall, update, discovery, and trust-boundary gaps.

recommendation.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract Before Merge
recommendation.body: Define and implement scoped install identity across install, uninstall, update, registry/index metadata, discovery, doctor, docs, and security validation before exposing the CLI flag.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across plugin install persistence and CLI lifecycle files and is the best available owner for the product/security direction choice.
